tolerances.rationale: Require >=5% validation MAE improvement on league anchor, <=5 extreme-bucket MAE, <=3 bucket bias, <=5.5 p90 error, <=0.15 subera regression, <=2 box-heavy bias. Practical bounds declared before candidate evaluation; no final-test values used.

root_cause.interpretation: Residual spread and conditional means diagnose compression; ablations identify model dependence, not causal player/coaching effects. Tail buckets condition on outcomes, so some mean regression is expected.

coverage.interpretation: Feature coverage/uncertainty only, not quality or probability; correlated features and unobserved lineup interactions limit interpretation.

uncertainty.interpretation: Uncalibrated uncertainty/coverage indicator, not defensive quality or a probability interval

custom_lineup.semantics: Five-player ironman only, 48 minutes each, 240 total; DRtg is a diagnostic estimate, not precise truth or a game simulation

verdict: B. DEFENSIVE MODEL STILL OUTSIDE ACCEPTANCE TOLERANCE
